name: habituation
description: Conditioned stimuli (CSs) or startle probes are presented prior to the acquisition phase; no US is presented

name: acquisition
description: A conditioned stimulus (CS+) is presented with an unconditioned stimulus (US). In differential fear conditioning paradigms, a second conditioned stimulus (CS-) is presented without the US.

name: extinction
description: The CS+ is (repeatedly) presented without the US.

name: generalization
description: Generalization stimuli (GSs) that resemble the CSs are presented alongside the CSs.

name: re-extinction
description: Post-extinction procedure: The CSs are presented again, with the CS+ no paired with the US. Also referred to as: spontaneous recovery, extinction recall, extinction retention test.

name: reinstatement test
description: Post-extinction procedure: Test of fear responses after an unannounced re-exposure to the US.

name: renewal
description: Post-extinction procedure: The CSs are presented without the US, accompanied by a change in context from the extinction and/or acquisition training phases.

name: reacquisition
description: Post-extinction procedure: The conditioned stimuli are presented again, and the CS+ is again presented with the US.

name: reversal
description: Post-extinction procedure: CS contingencies are reversed such that the former CS+ becomes unpaired and the CS− becomes paired.

name: intervention
description: Describes any type of intervention within a fear conditioning study, including pharmacological treatments, instrumental phases, avoidance, or other behavioral interventions.
